neighbours.label: function words and links in bioinformatics methods text about annotation databases and ontologies (Gene Ontology, KEGG, pathway databases)
fire: Differentially expressed genes were mapped to Gene Ontology terms and KEGG pathways.
Protein interactions were downloaded from the STRING database and filtered by score.
Functional enrichment was assessed using Reactome and the Gene Ontology biological process terms.
Transcripts were annotated against UniProt and the InterPro collection of protein families.
Pathway membership was taken from WikiPathways, a curated repository of signaling networks.
Orthologs were identified with the OrthoDB catalogue and assigned GO molecular function terms.
Variants were annotated with ClinVar and the Ensembl Variant Effect Predictor.
Metabolites were matched to the Human Metabolome Database and mapped onto KEGG modules.
quiet: Customer complaints were mapped to product categories and sales regions.
Flight records were downloaded from the airline database and filtered by date.
Survey answers were coded using the national occupation classification scheme.
Books were catalogued against the Library of Congress subject headings.
Recipes were taken from an online collection of regional cooking traditions.
Court cases were identified with a legal search engine and tagged by topic.
Addresses were matched with the postal register and the city zoning map.
Songs were matched to an online music archive and grouped by genre.
